constraints: Preserve provider configuration, usage history, statusline and hook integration, CLI behavior, and the existing ~/.headroom state.

steps.instructions: Install quotagauge, run its initialization for configured providers, verify settings rewrites and state migration, then uninstall headroom-cli.
steps.title: Move to quotagauge

verification.purpose: Initialize integrations and exercise the maintainer-provided state migration.

rule.summary: The maintainer states that headroom-cli is no longer maintained and development continues as quotagauge.
rule.title: headroom-cli was renamed and is no longer maintained
